title: Permutation Tree
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

Takahashi has an ability to generate a tree using a permutation $(p_1,p_2,...,p_n)$ of $(1,2,...,n)$, in the following process:

First, prepare Vertex $1$, Vertex $2$, ..., Vertex $N$. For each $i=1,2,...,n$, perform the following operation:

- If $p_i = 1$, do nothing.
- If $p_i \neq 1$, let $j'$ be the largest $j$ such that $p_j < p_i$. Span an edge between Vertex $i$ and Vertex $j'$.

Takahashi is trying to make his favorite tree with this ability. His favorite tree has $n$ vertices from Vertex $1$ through Vertex $n$, and its $i$-th edge connects Vertex $v_i$ and $w_i$. Determine if he can make a tree isomorphic to his favorite tree by using a proper permutation. If he can do so, find the lexicographically smallest such permutation.

## Note

For the definition of isomorphism of trees, see [wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Graph_isomorphism). Intuitively, two trees are isomorphic when they are the "same" if we disregard the indices of their vertices.

## Constraints

- $2 \leq n \leq 10^5$
- $1 \leq v_i, w_i \leq n$
- The given graph is a tree.

## Input

Input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
n
v_1 w_1
v_2 w_2
:
v_{n-1} w_{n-1}
```

## Output

If there is no permutation that can generate a tree isomorphic to Takahashi's favorite tree, print `-1`. If it exists, print the lexicographically smallest such permutation, with spaces in between.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

Takahashi 具有以下能力：给定 $(p_1,p_2,...,p_n)$ 的一个排列，可以通过如下过程生成一棵树：

首先，准备顶点 $1$、顶点 $2$、……、顶点 $N$。对于每个 $i=1,2,...,n$，执行以下操作：

- 如果 $p_i = 1$，则什么也不做。
- 如果 $p_i \neq 1$，令 $j'$ 为满足 $p_j < p_i$ 的最大的 $j$。在顶点 $i$ 和顶点 $j'$ 之间连一条边。

Takahashi 想要利用这一能力构造出他最喜欢的树。他最喜欢的树有 $n$ 个顶点，即顶点 $1$ 到顶点 $n$，其第 $i$ 条边连接顶点 $v_i$ 和 $w_i$。请判断他是否可以使用某个排列，生成一棵与他最喜欢的树同构的树。如果可以，请找出字典序最小的这样的排列。

## 说明

关于树的同构的定义，请参见 [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Graph_isomorphism)。直观地说，如果忽略顶点的编号，两棵树在“相同”的情况下就是同构的。

## 约束条件

- $2 \leq n \leq 10^5$
- $1 \leq v_i, w_i \leq n$
- 给定的图是一棵树。

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入按以下格式给出：

```
n
v_1 w_1
v_2 w_2
:
v_{n-1} w_{n-1}
```

## 输出格式

如果不存在能够生成一棵与 Takahashi 最喜欢的树同构的树的排列，输出 `-1`。否则，输出这样的排列中字典序最小的一个，元素之间用空格分隔。
